The tool returned a tuple with one product: a SMILES string of the precursor? Actually apply_template returns possible outcomes (precursor sets). It gave a tuple containing a tuple of one SMILES: "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". That's a single precursor? But the reaction likely splits into two precursors (maybe an ester and something). However the template may produce a single product (the precursor). The expected output format: list of lists, each inner list contains SMILES of each precursor. Here we have one precursor only. So answer should be [["CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1"]].

But need to verify if there are multiple outcomes. The result is a tuple of one tuple. Could be multiple outcomes but only one. So final answer.

Check if need to include the other precursor from earlier? The earlier answer from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-2 gave two SMILES: the target and some other? Actually that answer gave list of two SMILES: the target and "CCOP(=O)(OCC)[CH2]/[CH]=[CH]/[C](=O)[O]CC". That seems unrelated.

Thus final answer is list of list.
